content: # Toyota Motor Corp. For the full article, see Toyota Motor Corporation. **Toyota Motor Corp.**, Largest Japanese automobile manufacturer and one of the largest automotive companies in the world. It was established in 1933 as a division of the Toyoda Automatic Loom Works, Ltd., and in 1937 it was incorporated as the Toyota Motor Co., Ltd. Toyota later established many related companies, including Toyoda Machine Works, Ltd. (1941), and Toyota Auto Body, Ltd. In the 1960s and ’70s the company expanded rapidly, exporting large numbers of cars to foreign markets. Following consolidations among many of its business units, the company took the name Toyota Motor Corp. For the full article, see automobile. China and the U.S. are the world’s largest automobile markets; annual sales in China surpassed those in the U.S. for the first time in 2009.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation | Business and Management - EBSCO
content: Toyota Motor Corporation (TMC), founded in 1937 and headquartered in Toyota City, Aichi, Japan, is a leading global automobile manufacturer known for its diverse range of vehicles, including cars, trucks, and hybrids. It became the world's largest automaker in 2008 and remains a significant player in the automotive industry, employing over 370,000 individuals and producing more than 200 million vehicles since its inception. Toyota is recognized for pioneering the hybrid vehicle market with the introduction of the Prius in 1997, which was the first mass-produced hybrid automobile. Toyota's impact extends beyond manufacturing; it plays a significant role in the global economy and has strategic partnerships, such as its collaboration with Mazda. title: History of Toyota | TOYOTA Motor Manufacturing UK
content: toyota-world-banner-range.jpg. # History of Toyota. Toyota's origins lie in the Japanese weaving industry when Sakichi Toyoda invented the world's first automatic loom and, subsequently, set up the Toyoda Spinning and Weaving Company in 1918. This in turn led to the launch of the Company's first ever passenger car in 1936, the Model AA, and in 1937, the Toyota Motor Company was born. Production of Toyota vehicles outside Japan began in 1959 in Brazil and now, besides its own plants, manufacturing subsidiaries and affiliates in Japan, Toyota manufactures Toyota and Lexus brand vehicles and components throughout the world. title: Question of the Day: Today,... - Larz Anderson Auto Museum
content: ## Larz Anderson Auto Museum's post. ### **Larz Anderson Auto Museum**. Today, in 1937, Toyota Motor Co., Ltd. was founded. What do you consider the best early Toyota produced? I would pick the 1955 Toyopet Crown. The first vehicle fully designed by Toyota. The 1955 Crown exhibits influence from European designs (note strong resemblance to the Simca of this era) and some American styling elements like the side trim spears, and hints of finned rear fenders. A cool touch was the rear 'suicide doors' When introduced to the US market in 1958, it was considered too under powered for roads in the States. After not being well received, Toyota withdrew the Crown from America by the end of 1960. The Crown nameplate continues on to this day!
